name: AMCAF
author: Chris Hodges

provenance.note: The release before the registered 1.50. Its banner dates it 26-Dec-95. 268 of its 269 keyword names are also in 1.50, so 1.50 is 1.40 plus additions rather than a reworking -- which is why the 1.50 manual documents 1.40 and its author notes he had no time to update it.
provenance.redistribution: Uploaded to Aminet, whose terms require the submitter to state distribution conditions. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

notes: 269 keywords. AMCAF is freeware by its own manual. The registered 1.50 is the port target; this is here so a program built against 1.40 identifies as 1.40 rather than being mistaken for 1.50.
